Actions. This mishap takes its turn on initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties) and takes [[@prof - 1]] different actions from its options. It can’t take an action it took on its previous turn.

Reactions. It can take up to [[@prof - 1]] reactions per round and can’t take the same reaction it took most recently.

Work Radius. Its actions and reactions affect only creatures within [[5 * (@prof - 1)]] feet of it: those close enough to work on the affected system.

Countdown. It begins with [[@prof + 1]] countdown counters. At the end of each of its turns, if it still has at least 1 hit point, it loses 1 counter.
This mishap doesn’t require Diagnosis; its effects are immediately apparent.

This mishap is immune to Correct actions until it has been Diagnosed. A creature can use an action to Diagnose it with an Intelligence (Investigation or Arcana) or Computers check contested by the mishap’s Deception. On a success, the immunity ends.
When a creature attempts to Correct this mishap, its ability check is contested by the mishap’s Athletics.
When a creature attempts to Correct this mishap, its ability check is contested by the mishap’s Acrobatics.
When a creature attempts to Correct this mishap, its ability check is contested by the mishap’s Arcana.
When a creature attempts to Correct this mishap, its ability check is contested by the mishap’s Insight.
When a creature attempts to Correct this mishap, its ability check is contested by the mishap’s Deception.
Whenever this mishap would take damage of a type it feeds on (listed with its damage immunities), it instead regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

When this mishap has no countdown counters remaining, it is removed and the ship immediately gains either the next-worse version of this mishap in the same location or its escalation mishap in the same or an adjacent location, determined by the GM. Both are listed in its description.
This mishap regains [[5 * (@prof - 1)]] hit points.
Until the start of the next round, creatures have disadvantage on Correct and Diagnose checks against this mishap, and the area within the work radius is lightly obscured.

One creature within the work radius must succeed on a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Strength saving throw or be &Reference[Restrained apply=false] until the end of its next turn. While restrained this way, it has disadvantage on Strength and Dexterity saving throws.

One creature within the work radius must succeed on a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Strength saving throw or be pushed [[5 * (@prof - 1)]] feet in a direction of the GM’s choice and knocked &Reference[Prone apply=false].

Until the start of the next round, the area within the work radius is difficult terrain. A creature that starts its turn there must succeed on a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Dexterity saving throw or fall &Reference[Prone apply=false] and drop one held item of the GM’s choice.

Smoke, vapor, or fumes fill the work radius until the start of the next round. The area is heavily obscured, and a creature that starts its turn there must succeed on a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Constitution saving throw or be &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] until the end of its next turn.

One creature within the work radius must succeed on a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Wisdom saving throw or be &Reference[Charmed apply=false] by this mishap until the end of its next turn. While charmed this way, its speed is 0 and it has disadvantage on checks made to Correct the mishap.
The system this mishap afflicts (a weapon mount, station, engine, or ward) can’t be used until the start of the next round.

The GM chooses one effect that fits the afflicted system, lasting until the start of the next round: the ship’s Speed drops by 1 (minimum 1); the ship turns 1 facing; the ship’s AC drops by 1; the next action at the afflicted station costs 1 more Tempo; or the afflicted station has disadvantage on its next check.

Action. The mishap spreads to nearby material or systems: the ship gains a Minor version of this mishap (CR 1) in an unoccupied space within the work radius. A mishap of CR 15 or higher spreads its standard version (CR 5) instead.

Reaction. When this mishap takes force damage, roll a d20. On 11 or higher, it spreads as above.
The afflicted structure buckles. The ship takes [[@prof]]d8 bludgeoning damage.

The mishap destabilizes a neighboring system. The ship gains this mishap’s escalation mishap, one severity lower than this mishap (Minor for Minor and standard mishaps), in the same or an adjacent location (GM’s choice). It is listed in this mishap’s description.
The afflicted ship system gains a Mishap token (impaired; a second token takes it offline) until this mishap is Corrected.

Reaction. When the ship uses the system this mishap afflicts (fires its weapon, reroutes its power, maneuvers, raises its ward, and so on), roll a d20. On 11 or higher, this mishap regains [[5 * (@prof - 1)]] hit points.

Reaction. When a creature succeeds on a Correct or Diagnose action against this mishap, that creature must succeed on a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Strength saving throw or be pushed [[5 * (@prof - 2)]] feet and have disadvantage on its next ability check or attack roll before the end of its next turn.

Reaction. When this mishap is reduced below half its hit points for the first time, each creature within the work radius must succeed on a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Dexterity saving throw or be knocked &Reference[Prone apply=false].
Reaction. When a creature is pushed or slid by this mishap, it takes [[@prof - 2]]d8 bludgeoning damage as it strikes bulkheads or fixed structures.

When this mishap’s last countdown counter is removed, it detonates instead of Completing: each creature within [[5 * @prof]] feet of the affected system must make a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Dexterity saving throw, taking [[2 * @prof - 2]]d6 fire damage and [[2 * @prof - 2]]d6 thunder damage on a failed save, or half as much damage on a successful one.

After detonating, the mishap ends and the ship gains a Fire mishap and one random mishap, each one severity lower (Minor for Minor and standard explosions), in the same or adjacent locations.
If this mishap regains hit points for any reason, it vents violently and immediately uses Resist Correction against one creature within its work radius (GM’s choice).

This mishap can be &Reference[Grappled apply=false]. While grappled, it is treated as an object weighing [[150 * (@prof - 1)]] pounds for lifting, dragging, or throwing, and its affected system and detonation point move with it.

Violent Jolt (Reaction). When it is grappled or moved while grappled, the grappler must succeed on a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Strength or Dexterity saving throw (grappler’s choice) or take [[@prof]]d6 thunder damage and be knocked &Reference[Prone apply=false]; on a success, the movement continues.

Escalation mishap (Trigger Instability): Critical Loss of Power (CR 15).

Feeds on: cold damage.

description.value:
Actions. This mishap takes its turn on initiative count 20 (losing initiative ties) and takes [[@prof - 1]] different actions from its options. It can’t take an action it took on its previous turn.

Reactions. It can take up to [[@prof - 1]] reactions per round and can’t take the same reaction it took most recently.

Work Radius. Its actions and reactions affect only creatures within [[5 * (@prof - 1)]] feet of it: those close enough to work on the affected system.

Countdown. It begins with [[@prof + 1]] countdown counters. At the end of each of its turns, if it still has at least 1 hit point, it loses 1 counter.
This mishap doesn’t require Diagnosis; its effects are immediately apparent.
When a creature attempts to Correct this mishap, its ability check is contested by the mishap’s Athletics.
Whenever this mishap would take damage of a type it feeds on (listed with its damage immunities), it instead regains hit points equal to the damage dealt.

When this mishap has no countdown counters remaining, it is removed and the ship immediately gains either the next-worse version of this mishap in the same location or its escalation mishap in the same or an adjacent location, determined by the GM. Both are listed in its description.

Action. One creature within the work radius must make a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Constitution saving throw, taking [[@prof]]d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one, and it has disadvantage on its next ability check before the end of its next turn.

Backfire (Reaction). When a creature fails a Correct action against this mishap, the mishap uses Resist Correction against that creature.
This mishap regains [[5 * (@prof - 1)]] hit points.
Until the start of the next round, creatures have disadvantage on Correct and Diagnose checks against this mishap, and the area within the work radius is lightly obscured.

The GM chooses one effect that fits the afflicted system, lasting until the start of the next round: the ship’s Speed drops by 1 (minimum 1); the ship turns 1 facing; the ship’s AC drops by 1; the next action at the afflicted station costs 1 more Tempo; or the afflicted station has disadvantage on its next check.

Reaction. When the ship uses the system this mishap afflicts (fires its weapon, reroutes its power, maneuvers, raises its ward, and so on), roll a d20. On 11 or higher, this mishap regains [[5 * (@prof - 1)]] hit points.
The system this mishap afflicts (a weapon mount, station, engine, or ward) can’t be used until the start of the next round.

The mishap destabilizes a neighboring system. The ship gains this mishap’s escalation mishap, one severity lower than this mishap (Minor for Minor and standard mishaps), in the same or an adjacent location (GM’s choice). It is listed in this mishap’s description.

Reaction. When a creature succeeds on a Correct or Diagnose action against this mishap, that creature must succeed on a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Strength saving throw or be pushed [[5 * (@prof - 2)]] feet and have disadvantage on its next ability check or attack roll before the end of its next turn.

Action. Each creature within the work radius must make a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Constitution saving throw, taking [[@prof]]d6 cold damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.

Hazard Zone (Reaction). When a creature ends its turn within the work radius, it must succeed on a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Constitution saving throw or take [[@prof - 2]]d6 cold damage.

Smoke, vapor, or fumes fill the work radius until the start of the next round. The area is heavily obscured, and a creature that starts its turn there must succeed on a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Constitution saving throw or be &Reference[Poisoned apply=false] until the end of its next turn.
The afflicted ship system gains a Mishap token (impaired; a second token takes it offline) until this mishap is Corrected.

Reaction. When this mishap is reduced below half its hit points for the first time, each creature within the work radius must succeed on a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Dexterity saving throw or be knocked &Reference[Prone apply=false].
The afflicted structure buckles. The ship takes [[@prof]]d8 bludgeoning damage.

Backfire (Reaction). When a creature fails a Correct action against this mishap, the mishap uses Resist Correction against that creature.
This mishap regains [[5 * (@prof - 1)]] hit points.

Action. Each creature within the work radius must make a DC [[@attributes.spell.dc]] Constitution saving throw, taking [[@prof]]d6 lightning damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one.
